chunks: And it is narrated from Ṣafwān al-Jammāl that he said:
I prayed behind Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام for several days, and he would perform qunut in every salat (prayer), whether it was recited aloud or not.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the kunyah of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَفْوَانَ الْجَمَّالِ: Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, the narrator reporting the Imam’s practice
key_terms.يَقْنُتُ: he would perform qunut, the supplicatory standing in salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُجْهَرُ: is recited aloud, referring to audible prayer recitation

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام perform qunut in both audible and silent prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding qunut in salat (prayer). It indicates that he observed qunut in every prayer, whether the recitation was audible or silent, making it a significant proof in prayer rulings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.943 - It is reported from Safwan al-Jammal that He said:
“I prayed behind Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) for several days, and he would make the Qunoot in every prayer, whether he recited aloud or not”.
